name: government_involvement_profile
artifact_type: CCI declarative design specification; NOT a Rainbird import or validated export
deployment_status: published build supplied by user; live validation pending
sufficiency_relationships: For each terminal relationship add a singular relationship named <terminal>_sufficiency to Evidence Sufficiency

intermediate_conclusions.eligible_contract: evaluation contains_contract C AND evaluation identity_verified true AND C attribution_verified true
intermediate_conclusions.historical_witness: eligible_contract C AND C signature_band historical
intermediate_conclusions.recent_witness: eligible_contract C AND C signature_band recent
intermediate_conclusions.execution_witness: eligible_contract C AND C execution_status execution AND C observation_available true
intermediate_conclusions.temporal_coverage: direct_coverage AND every eligible contract has signature_band historical or recent
intermediate_conclusions.execution_coverage: direct_coverage AND every eligible contract has observation_available true AND execution_status not unknown AND source_stale false

direct_participation: no_scoped_matches if direct_coverage and no eligible_contract exists
historical_participation: not_observed_in_scope if temporal_coverage and no historical_witness
recent_participation: not_observed_in_scope if temporal_coverage and no recent_witness
currently_reported_execution: reported if execution_witness exists AND source_stale false
not_observed_in_scope if execution_coverage and no execution_witness
evidence_sufficiency: limited is reserved; never emitted in v1
stale qualifies each dimension when source_stale true; execution remains undetermined
missing when freshness is unknown; valid direct/historical/recent witnesses may remain documented
identity_verified false or absent: outcomes undetermined, sufficiency missing
an unaffected positive witness supports sufficient despite unrelated contradictions or incomplete retrieval
without a witness: relevant contradictory evidence outranks incomplete coverage, then missing required facts
sufficient negative requires complete relevant coverage and facts

constraints: Rules must have disjoint guards; do not rely on undocumented first-rule priority.
No closed-world inference from an unanswered query. Explicit coverage facts guard all negatives.
CCI does not inject terminal outcomes or sufficiency conclusions.
Current SECOP deduplication excludes entire unresolved versions, even for monetary-only conflicts. Do not reinstate these without a separate reviewed evidence change.
Company, Screening Run, Source Observation and Evidence Record are represented by the local evaluation envelope and provenance map, not transmitted personal or supplier identifiers.
Rules requiring universal collection coverage need validation in Studio before publishing. This JSON is not executable syntax.
Compare supplied contract_count to distinct contained contract instances; mismatch blocks negatives, absent count has no independent effect.
Do not assume missing attribution or conflict facts are false.
Never inject inferred relationships, terminal outcomes or sufficiency as overrides.
input_boolean_encoding: Native JSON true/false, never strings; omitted conflict diagnostics remain unknown.
